newsitem.title: USA: LottoWorld signs agreement with Georgia Lottery.
newsitem.headline: LottoWorld signs agreement with Georgia Lottery.

text.p: LottoWorld Inc said on Monday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Lottery Players Publishing Co Inc, signed an exclusive agreement with the Georgia Lottery Corp to publish a new monthly magazine.
The new magazine, Georgia Lottery Players Digest, would boast an initial circulation of 400,000 copies monthly.
LottoWorld, through its Lottery Players Publishing Co. subsidiary, also publishes other magazines in conjunction with state lotteries, in an industry that spends more than $34 billion annually.
